comms.lead: Every e-mail, SMS and WhatsApp message to and from students and leads, in one place.
comms.inbox_empty_text: Replies by WhatsApp and SMS arrive here once those channels are connected in Settings.
comms.none_text: Messages you send from lead and student pages are listed here.
comms.subject: Subject
comms.not_connected_saved: {channel} is not connected yet, so nothing was sent. The attempt is recorded on the timeline.
comms.channel_not_connected: This channel is not connected yet, so messages cannot be sent from here.
comms.no_address: This person has no address for this channel. Add it to their record first.
comms.no_address_email: This person has no e-mail address.
comms.no_address_sms: This person has no phone number.
comms.no_address_whatsapp: This person has no WhatsApp or phone number.
comms.whatsapp_window: WhatsApp only delivers free text within 24 hours of the person’s last message. “Open in WhatsApp” sends it from your own phone and records it here.
comms.no_address_portal: Only students with a portal account can receive portal messages.

templates.lead: Messages sent automatically and from the composer, in English and Arabic, per channel. Edits replace the built-in text; reset to go back.
templates.channel_hint: SMS and WhatsApp use the message only (no subject). Leave empty to reuse the e-mail text.
templates.button_hint: Shown when the message links to a page (portal, booking, ticket).
templates.variables_hint: Click to copy, then paste into the text. Unknown variables are left empty.
templates.reset_confirm: Remove your edits for this channel?
templates.preview_hint: Sample values are shown in [brackets]. Save to update the preview.

integrations.provider_hint: Google and Microsoft use their SMTP servers with an app password (host and port are filled in for you).
integrations.password_hint: Leave empty to keep the saved value.
integrations.encrypted: Passwords and tokens are encrypted before they are stored and are never shown again.
integrations.email_from_env: E-mail currently uses the SMTP settings from the server configuration (.env). Saving a connection here replaces them.
integrations.test_body: This is a test message: your e-mail connection works.
integrations.twilio_help: SMS are sent through Twilio. Find the Account SID and auth token in the Twilio console; the sender is a Twilio number or approved sender ID.
integrations.country_code_hint: Used for local numbers that start with 0, e.g. 962 for Jordan.
integrations.twilio_webhooks: In Twilio, set the number’s incoming message webhook and the status callback to:
integrations.whatsapp_manual: Without an API connection, staff can still click “Open in WhatsApp” on a record: the message opens on their phone and is logged here.
integrations.whatsapp_help: Uses the WhatsApp Business Cloud API (Meta). Create an app in Meta for Developers, add WhatsApp, and copy the phone number ID and a permanent access token.
integrations.app_secret_hint: Used to verify that incoming webhooks really come from Meta. Required to receive messages.
integrations.meta_webhook: In Meta, subscribe the app to “messages” with this callback URL and verify token:
integrations.verify_after_save: The verify token is created when you save.

finance.overview_lead: Money in and out for the selected period. Totals are per currency.
finance.invoices_lead: Invoices for students and leads, from draft to paid.
finance.payments_lead: Every payment received, with receipts. Export for accounting.
finance.commissions_lead: Commissions expected from partner universities. Created automatically when an application at a partner university reaches “Enrolled”.
finance.per_currency: Amounts in different currencies are listed separately and never added together.
finance.no_invoices_text: Create an invoice from a student’s Finance tab or here.
finance.no_payments_text: Payments recorded on invoices appear here.
finance.pick_person: Who is this invoice for? Open the student and use “New invoice” on their Finance tab, or enter the student number.
finance.pick_person_hint: The student’s ID is the number in their page address (/staff/students/123).
finance.due_hint: Leave empty for the default payment term.
finance.doc_line_ph: e.g. Application service — University of Manchester
finance.notes_hint: Payment instructions, bank details, terms. Shown on the invoice.
finance.reference_hint: Bank transfer reference, card slip number, cheque number…
finance.no_commissions_text: Add partner agreements; commissions are created when students enrol at partner universities.
finance.no_agreement: No active agreement with a commission rate applies to this application.
finance.how_to_pay: Questions about this invoice or how to pay?
finance.rate_hint: Percent of first-year tuition, or a fixed amount when the type is “fixed”.

doc.void_note: This invoice was cancelled and is not payable.
doc.footer: Thank you for choosing Global Education Consultants.

finance.online_thanks: Thank you — your payment is being confirmed by the card processor. The invoice updates automatically within a minute; a receipt is e-mailed when it does.
finance.online_cancelled: The card payment was cancelled. Nothing was charged.
finance.online_note: You will pay on Stripe’s secure page. GEC never sees your card details.
finance.online_review: An online payment of {amount} {currency} needs review (the invoice was already settled).

payments.how: Create a Stripe account, paste the secret key and the webhook signing secret below, then add the webhook address in Stripe → Developers → Webhooks. Invoices then show a “Pay by card” button; the payment is recorded automatically when Stripe confirms it.
payments.secret_key_hint: Stripe → Developers → API keys. A restricted key needs write access to Checkout Sessions. Checked with Stripe when saved.
payments.webhook_secret_hint: Shown in Stripe after you add the webhook endpoint (starts with whsec_).
payments.webhook_help: Add this endpoint in Stripe and select the events below.
payments.no_cards: Card details are entered on Stripe’s page and never reach this server.
